#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

int main() {
    int w, m;
    std::cin >> w >> m;

    std::vector<int> all;
    while (m != 0) {
        all.push_back(m % w);
        m /= w;
    }

    bool ok = true;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)all.size(); ++i) {
        if (all[i] == 0 || all[i] == 1)
            continue;
        if (all[i] == w - 1) {
            int j = i + 1;
            while (j < (int)all.size()) {
                if (all[j] == w - 1) {
                    all[j] = 0;
                    ++j;
                } else {
                    all[j]++;
                    break;
                }
            }
            continue;
        }
        ok = false;
        break;
    }

    if (ok)
        std::cout << "YES" << std::endl;
    else
        std::cout << "NO" << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
